description: Return ONE whole Alfa Laval machine data sheet in a single call, with no paging: every figure Alfa Laval printed for it (capacity, bowl speed, motor power, solids space, weight, dimensions) with its condition, unit, source document, page and a ready-to-quote sentence, plus the documents and how many units of that model sit on Dolphin's inventory sheet (ready-built vs remanufactured to order). Model names written many ways work: "MOPX 207", "MOPX207", "mopx-207 TGT", "Alfa Laval MAB 204S". A bare family such as "MOPX" returns the list of models; a variant name returns the machine with each figure tagged by variant; no match returns the closest models, never an empty error. Figures are Alfa Laval's as printed, not Dolphin measurements or guarantees. This tool has no prices and no parts or drawings.

model.description: Machine model written any way, e.g. "MOPX 207", "MOPX207", "WHPX 510TGD" or "MAB 204S". A bare family such as "MOPX" returns the list of models.
